Name: Dashboard
Description: Cross-website home screen aggregating key traffic KPIs and per-site summaries so users see the whole workspace at a glance.

Name: Boards
Description: Custom boards where users arrange saved reports from one or more websites into a drag-and-drop layout for recurring monitoring.

Name: Websites
Description: Manage tracked websites in a workspace: create, configure, copy the tracking script, transfer ownership, and delete.

Name: Links
Description: Create and manage short links that record click events, making campaign traffic measurable without embedding the tracker.

Name: Pixels
Description: Create and manage tracking pixels to record opens and visits from emails or pages where the tracking script cannot be embedded.

Name: Overview
Description: Default website report: views, visitors, sessions, bounce rate and time on site, plus a pageviews time-series and top dimensions.

Name: Event
Description: Report of custom events sent by the tracker, with drill-down into event attributes (e.g. click event properties) and their values.

Name: Session
Description: Session-level report listing visitor sessions with device, location and referrer, and the activity sequence inside each session.

Name: Realtime
Description: Live view of currently active visitors and recent events, refreshed by polling, for monitoring traffic as it happens.

Name: Performance
Description: Core Web Vitals report collected from real visitors, showing how fast pages actually load and respond.

Name: Compare
Description: Compare a website's metrics across two date ranges side by side to spot growth and regressions.

Name: Breakdown
Description: Slice metrics across multiple dimensions at once (page, source, device, country) to see where the numbers come from.

Name: Goals
Description: Define target events or pageviews and track completion progress against a goal value over a chosen period.

Name: Funnels
Description: Multi-step conversion funnel showing how many visitors reach each step and where they drop off.

Name: Journeys
Description: Path analysis of the page and event sequences visitors follow, revealing common routes and dead ends.

Name: Retention
Description: Cohort retention report showing what share of visitors come back after 1 day, 1 week or longer.

Name: Replays
Description: Session replay of recorded real user sessions, enabled per website, for qualitative behaviour analysis.

Name: Heatmaps
Description: Click and scroll heatmaps over a page, showing where visitors interact and how far down they scroll.

Name: Segments
Description: Reusable saved filters on visitor, session and event attributes that can be applied across reports.

Name: Cohorts
Description: Group visitors by a shared trait or first-action period and track how each group behaves over time.

Name: UTM
Description: Report on utm_source, medium, campaign, term and content to measure which marketing campaigns bring traffic.

Name: Revenue
Description: Track revenue events by amount and currency, and see which pages, sources and campaigns generate income.

Name: Attribution
Description: Attribute conversions back to the channels and campaigns that drove them, so marketing effort can be judged by outcome.

Name: SDK Android
Description: Native Android SDK to send screen views and custom events from mobile apps into the same analytics pipeline.

Name: SDK iOS
Description: Native iOS SDK to send screen views and custom events from mobile apps into the same analytics pipeline.
